caption: The drawing depicts a large tankard with a lidded top as the central object, rendered in stippled black-and-white shading on a beige background. The tankard has a visibly ornate, curved handle on the left with a decorative flourish at its base, and a circular lid adorned with intricate patterns, which is depicted both in the context of the tankard and in detail as a top-down view below the main image. Adjacent to the detailed lid view is a view of the tankard’s latch mechanism. In the lower right corner, there is a simplified side profile of the tankard, showing its handle, spout, and lid in outline. The artist’s signature, “G. Capelli,” is located near the simplified profile. The entire arrangement sits within a double-lined rectangular border. The composition features no additional colors beyond the pencil shading.
title: Silver Tankard
